notes: MPC-2610 is a broadcast PTZ camera. Added to PTP3 in v1.2.0 (Sep 2024) alongside ILME-FX6. T-Number (0xD000) and Iris Display Unit (0xD003) were added in the same release — MPC-2610 is one of the cameras that supports T-Number. Built-in ND filter. PTZ controls via SDIO_ControlPTZF. Live view via LiveViewURL (0xD278). Battery=false: AC-powered broadcast camera. Changed in v1.3.0 compatibility: 'Maximum number of bytes' enabled for MPC-2610.
